WITH grade_starts AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN GSserved IS NULL OR TRIM(GSserved) = '' THEN NULL
           WHEN INSTR(GSserved, '-') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, '-') - 1))
           ELSE TRIM(GSserved)
         END AS start_grade
  FROM schools
  WHERE NCESDist = '0632640'
)
SELECT start_grade AS lowest_grade_level
FROM grade_starts
WHERE start_grade IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE
           WHEN LOWER(start_grade) IN ('p', 'ps', 'preschool') THEN -2
           WHEN LOWER(start_grade) IN ('tk', 'transitional kindergarten') THEN -1
           WHEN LOWER(start_grade) = 'k' THEN 0
           WHEN start_grade GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(start_grade AS INTEGER)
           ELSE 999
         END
LIMIT 1;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.Charter,
    s.GSserved,
    1.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.AvgScrRead IS NULL OR sat.AvgScrMath IS NULL OR sat.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
      WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
      ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 12
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC) AS rate_rank
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  School AS school_name,
  printf('%.4f', free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
  CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN Charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
  GSserved AS grades_served,
  sat_performance AS sat_performance_level
FROM ranked
WHERE rate_rank = 1

WITH eligible AS (

    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Charter,
    s.GSserved,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(SUBSTR(s.GSserved, INSTR(s.GSserved, '-') + 1)) = '12'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(free_meal_rate) OVER () AS max_rate
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT
  r.school_name,
  ROUND(r.free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
  CASE r.Charter
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes'
    WHEN 0 THEN 'No'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS charter_school,
  r.GSserved AS grades_served,
  CASE
    WHEN sat.cds IS NULL
      OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0
      OR sat.AvgScrRead IS NULL
      OR sat.AvgScrMath IS NULL
      OR sat.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
    WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
    ELSE 'Above Average'
  END AS sat_performance_level
FROM ranked AS r
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = r.CDSCode
WHERE r.free_meal_rate = r.max_rate
ORDER BY r.school_name

    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
post_totals AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NOT NULL THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END), 0) AS germany_editor_post_score,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NULL THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END), 0) AS other_post_score
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN users u
      ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
     AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
)
SELECT
    post_totals.germany_editor_post_score,
    post_totals.other_post_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM germany_editors) AS germany_last_editor_user_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Reputation), 0) FROM germany_editors) AS germany_editors_combined_reputation
FROM post_totals;

WITH badge_counts AS (
  SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_total
  FROM users AS u
  LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
  WHERE u.Location = 'Germany'
  GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
), ranked_totals AS (
  SELECT badge_total,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS total_rank
  FROM badge_counts
)
SELECT bc.DisplayName, bc.badge_total
FROM badge_counts AS bc
WHERE bc.badge_total = (
  SELECT badge_total
  FROM ranked_totals
  WHERE total_rank = 2
)
ORDER BY bc.DisplayName;

  SELECT v.UserId, COUNT(*) AS upvote_count
  FROM votes AS v
  WHERE v.VoteTypeId = 2
    AND v.UserId IS NOT NULL

)

       ROUND(AVG(CAST(us.Age AS REAL)), 2) AS avg_age

JOIN users AS us ON us.Id = pr.UserId

WITH months(month_start) AS (
  SELECT date('2010-01-01')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
  FROM months
  WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
), monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT m.month_start,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Id IS NOT NULL THEN pl.PostId END) AS post_count
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN postLinks pl
    ON pl.CreationDate >= m.month_start
   AND pl.CreationDate < date(m.month_start, '+1 month')
  LEFT JOIN posts p
    ON p.Id = pl.PostId
   AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
  GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(post_count), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM monthly_counts

treatment.sql:
WITH months(month_num) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month_num + 1 FROM months WHERE month_num < 12
), monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pl.PostId) AS post_count
    FROM postLinks pl
    JOIN posts p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
    WHERE pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND pl.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
      AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', pl.CreationDate) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(mc.post_count, 0)), 2) AS average_posts_per_month
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts mc ON mc.month_num = m.month_num;

WITH target_post AS (
  SELECT Id
  FROM posts
  WHERE Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
), editor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ph.UserId,
    COALESCE(u.DisplayName, ph.UserDisplayName) AS DisplayName,
    COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
  FROM postHistory AS ph
  JOIN target_post AS tp ON tp.Id = ph.PostId
  LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
  WHERE ph.PostHistoryTypeId = 5
    AND ph.Comment IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(ph.Comment) <> ''
  GROUP BY ph.UserId, COALESCE(u.DisplayName, ph.UserDisplayName)
)
SELECT DisplayName, edit_comment_count
FROM editor_counts
WHERE edit_comment_count = (SELECT MAX(edit_comment_count) FROM editor_counts)
ORDER BY DisplayName;

    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),

    SELECT t.team_short_name,
           t.team_api_id
    FROM Team t

),
qualifying_names AS (
    SELECT team_short_name
    FROM short_names
    GROUP BY team_short_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) > 1
),

           ta.chanceCreationPassing,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id
               ORDER BY date(ta.date) DESC, ta.id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE date(ta.date) <= date('2014-09-19')
)

       COUNT(DISTINCT s.team_api_id) AS club_count,
       ROUND(AVG(r.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk

),
attributes_on_date AS (
    SELECT team_api_id,
           chanceCreationPassing,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY team_api_id
               ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2014-09-19'
),
qualifying_short_names AS (

           COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS club_count

    GROUP BY t.team_short_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) > 1
)

       q.club_count,
       ROUND(AVG(a.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS average_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM qualifying_short_names q
JOIN Team t ON t.team_short_name = q.team_short_name
JOIN risky_teams r ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN attributes_on_date a
  ON a.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
 AND a.rn = 1

WITH gold_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cl.gender, d.account_id
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
), account_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gh.gender, ac.district_id
  FROM gold_holders gh
  JOIN account_avg aa ON aa.account_id = gh.account_id AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
  JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = gh.account_id
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = ac.district_id
  WHERE CAST(di.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
), district_stats AS (
  SELECT q.gender, di.district_id, CAST(di.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants, di.A11 AS salary, di.A13 AS urban_ratio
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = q.district_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS max_inhabitants
  FROM district_stats
)
SELECT CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' ELSE gender END AS gender,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS district_count,
       district_id AS most_inhabitant_district_id,
       inhabitants AS most_inhabitant_district_inhabitants,
       ROUND(AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 2) AS average_salary,
       ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 2) AS average_urban_inhabitant_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE inhabitants = max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, district_id

WITH eligible_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
  FROM client AS c
  JOIN disp AS owner_disp
    ON owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
   AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN account AS acct
    ON acct.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM card AS ca
      WHERE ca.disp_id = owner_disp.disp_id
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan AS lo
      WHERE lo.account_id = acct.account_id
    )
),
eligible_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM eligible_clients
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region,
         d.A11 AS salary,
         d.A12 AS unemployment_1996,
         d.A2 AS district_name,
         d.A4 AS inhabitants,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY d.A3
           ORDER BY d.A4 DESC, d.A2 ASC
         ) AS district_rank
  FROM eligible_districts AS e
  JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = e.district_id
)
SELECT region,
       ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_district_salary,
       ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996), 2) AS average_1996_unemployment_rate,
       MAX(CASE WHEN district_rank = 1 THEN district_name END) AS most_populous_district
FROM ranked_districts
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.type AS card_type,
        cl.district_id,
        d.A4 AS home_district,
        d.A8 AS inhabitants
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE lower(c.type) IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
), minima AS (
    SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM eligible
    GROUP BY card_type
)
SELECT e.card_type, e.home_district, e.inhabitants
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN minima AS m
  ON m.card_type = e.card_type
 AND m.min_inhabitants = e.inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE lower(e.card_type)
             WHEN 'gold' THEN 1
             WHEN 'classic' THEN 2
             WHEN 'junior' THEN 3
         END,
         e.home_district;

WITH litomerice AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
opened_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    WHERE a.date >= '1996-01-01' AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
latest_tx AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY t.account_id
               ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN opened_accounts AS oa ON oa.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date < '1997-01-01'
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT oa.account_id, oa.district_id, lt.balance
    FROM opened_accounts AS oa
    LEFT JOIN latest_tx AS lt ON lt.account_id = oa.account_id AND lt.rn = 1
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
           COUNT(*) AS account_count,
           ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS average_balance,
           AVG(ab.balance) AS raw_average
    FROM account_balances AS ab
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
    JOIN litomerice AS l ON d.A3 = l.region
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS region_average_balance
    FROM account_balances AS ab
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
    JOIN litomerice AS l ON d.A3 = l.region
)
SELECT ds.district_name,
       ds.account_count,
       ds.average_balance,
       rs.region_average_balance,
       (SELECT district_name
        FROM district_stats
        ORDER BY raw_average DESC, district_name ASC
        LIMIT 1) AS highest_average_district
FROM district_stats AS ds
CROSS JOIN region_stats AS rs
ORDER BY ds.district_name ASC

WITH district_withdrawals AS (
  SELECT a.district_id,
         SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
account_counts AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
standing_orders AS (
  SELECT a.district_id,
         SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing_order_debit
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT d.district_id,
         d.A2 AS district_name,
         d.A3 AS region,
         d.A11 AS population,
         dw.total_withdrawn,
         1.0 * dw.total_withdrawn / d.A11 AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
         1.0 * COALESCE(so.total_standing_order_debit, 0) / ac.account_count AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN district_withdrawals AS dw ON dw.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN account_counts AS ac ON ac.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN standing_orders AS so ON so.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A11 >= 100000
)
SELECT district_name,
       region,
       population,
       total_withdrawn,
       ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS district_rank,
       ROUND(avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM qualified
ORDER BY district_rank, district_name

WITH withdrawal_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
order_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing_order_debit
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
           d.A3 AS region,
           d.A4 AS population,
           w.total_withdrawn,
           1.0 * w.total_withdrawn / d.A4 AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
           COALESCE(o.total_standing_order_debit, 0.0) * 1.0
               / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS average_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawal_by_district AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN order_by_district AS o ON o.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4,
             w.total_withdrawn, o.total_standing_order_debit
)
SELECT district_name,
       region,
       population,
       total_withdrawn,
       ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC)
           AS withdrawal_per_inhabitant_rank,
       ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2)
           AS average_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM qualified
ORDER BY withdrawal_per_inhabitant_rank, district_name;

WITH target_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date, a.frequency, a.district_id AS account_district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp p ON p.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE p.client_id = 3541
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_accounts ta ON ta.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
regional_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS home_client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
district_population_ranks AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A8 AS inhabitants,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY d.A8 DESC) AS population_rank
    FROM district d
),
most_populous AS (
    SELECT region, district_name, inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT d.A3 AS region, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A8 AS inhabitants,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY d.A8 DESC, d.district_id) AS rn
        FROM district d
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ta.account_id,
       ta.opened_date,
       ta.frequency,
       ad.A2 AS district_name,
       ad.A3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN ad.district_id = hc.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
       ad.A11 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(tt.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       COALESCE(rcc.home_client_count, 0) AS region_home_client_count,
       mp.district_name AS most_populous_district,
       mp.inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
       dpr.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM target_accounts ta
JOIN district ad ON ad.district_id = ta.account_district_id
JOIN disp p ON p.account_id = ta.account_id AND p.client_id = 3541
JOIN client hc ON hc.client_id = 3541
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = ta.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals tt ON tt.account_id = ta.account_id
LEFT JOIN regional_client_counts rcc ON rcc.region = ad.A3
LEFT JOIN most_populous mp ON mp.region = ad.A3
JOIN district_population_ranks dpr ON dpr.district_id = ad.district_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(tt.transaction_count, 0) DESC, ta.account_id ASC

), transaction_totals AS (

       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(tt.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       rs.home_client_count AS regional_home_client_count,
       dr_pop.district_name AS most_populous_district,

WITH start_times AS (
  SELECT c.circuitRef,
         CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds_after_midnight
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND length(r.time) >= 8
), extrema AS (
  SELECT MIN(seconds_after_midnight) AS earliest_seconds,
         MAX(seconds_after_midnight) AS latest_seconds
  FROM start_times
), boundary_refs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.circuitRef, st.seconds_after_midnight
  FROM start_times st
)
SELECT 'earliest' AS boundary,
       group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') AS circuit_refs,
       earliest_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
       latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM boundary_refs, extrema
WHERE seconds_after_midnight = earliest_seconds
GROUP BY earliest_seconds, latest_seconds
UNION ALL
SELECT 'latest' AS boundary,
       group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') AS circuit_refs,
       latest_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
       latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM boundary_refs, extrema
WHERE seconds_after_midnight = latest_seconds
GROUP BY earliest_seconds, latest_seconds;

WITH race_start_times AS (
  SELECT
    c.circuitRef,
    CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
extrema AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_seconds,
    MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_seconds
  FROM race_start_times
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
      FROM race_start_times
      WHERE start_seconds = extrema.earliest_seconds
      ORDER BY circuitRef
    )
  ) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
  (
    SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
      FROM race_start_times
      WHERE start_seconds = extrema.latest_seconds
      ORDER BY circuitRef
    )
  ) AS latest_circuit_refs,
  extrema.earliest_seconds AS earliest_start_seconds_after_midnight,
  extrema.latest_seconds AS latest_start_seconds_after_midnight,
  extrema.latest_seconds - extrema.earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM extrema;

  FROM member AS mem
  JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major

FROM major_enrollment

WITH per_event_budget AS (
  SELECT link_to_event AS event_id,
         SUM(amount) AS total_budget,
         SUM(spent) AS total_spending
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
purchase_counts AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id,
         COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
  FROM expense x
  JOIN budget b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN per_event_budget b ON b.event_id = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts p ON p.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'closed'
  AND COALESCE(b.total_spending, 0) <= COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0)
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.purchase_count, 0) DESC, e.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH item_expenses AS (
  SELECT
    b.category,
    TRIM(item.value) AS item_name,
    e.cost
  FROM expense AS e
  JOIN budget AS b
    ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
  JOIN event AS ev
    ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
  JOIN json_each(
    CASE
      WHEN json_valid(e.expense_description) THEN
        CASE
          WHEN json_type(e.expense_description) = 'array' THEN e.expense_description
          ELSE json_array(e.expense_description)
        END
      ELSE json_array(e.expense_description)
    END
  ) AS item
  WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(e.approved)) IN ('yes', 'true', '1')
)
SELECT
  item_name,
  category,
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost_usd
FROM item_expenses
GROUP BY category, item_name
ORDER BY category, item_name;

WITH per_molecule AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type <> '-')
      THEN 'every bond single'
      ELSE 'not every bond single'
    END AS saturation_group
  FROM molecule m
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    saturation_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
  FROM per_molecule
  GROUP BY saturation_group
)
SELECT
  saturation_group,
  carcinogenic_count,
  non_carcinogenic_count,
  carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count AS count_difference
FROM counts
ORDER BY CASE saturation_group WHEN 'every bond single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

WITH bond_status AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN bond_count > 0 AND bond_count = single_bond_count
        THEN 'every bond is a single bond'
      ELSE 'all other molecules'
    END AS saturation_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
  FROM bond_status
  GROUP BY CASE
    WHEN bond_count > 0 AND bond_count = single_bond_count
      THEN 'every bond is a single bond'
    ELSE 'all other molecules'
  END
)
SELECT saturation_group, carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM grouped
ORDER BY CASE saturation_group
  WHEN 'every bond is a single bond' THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END;

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom AS a1
        ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
       AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom AS a2
        ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
       AND a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C'
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY COALESCE(cbc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
                 ac.number_of_atoms DESC,
                 m.molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank,
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
    ac.number_of_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
    ac.carbon_atoms,
    ac.chlorine_atoms,
    COALESCE(cbc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
    COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_bond_counts AS cbc ON cbc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE ac.carbon_atoms > 0
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM (
  SELECT b.bond_id,
         CASE WHEN a1.element = 'C' THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS element
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE m.label = '-'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
    AND (
      (a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element <> 'C')
      OR (a2.element = 'C' AND a1.element <> 'C')
    )
) AS carbon_element_bonds
GROUP BY element;

WITH bond_profile AS (

    b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
      ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element
    END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  bp.bond_kind_symbol,
  bp.bond_count,
  bp.element_pair_count,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_profile bp
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY bp.bond_count DESC, bp.bond_kind_symbol ASC
